slight wear and dark spots on surface

detail.issues: Model A has a less detailed and less realistic surface texture compared to Model B, which more closely matches the reference's aged bronze appearance with visible wear and patina.

Model A has darker necks and less defined highlights compared to the reference. Model B has a slightly different shape with a more rounded body and narrower neck, and its highlights are less distinct.
Model A has geometric distortions in the flower shape and color inaccuracies with darker tones. Model B has simplified flower geometry and lacks the detailed petal structure of the reference.

Model A has incorrect spring shape (straight/linear instead of circular), wrong red handle shape, and wrong color tone. Model B has correct circular spring shape but incorrect red handle shape and color, plus darker gray tone.
Model A lacks realistic texture details and the leather's worn appearance, while Model B has incorrect text content and a stitched pattern on the cover that doesn't match the reference.

Model A has simplified and incorrect decorative patterns, darkened color, and simplified stem structure. Model B has incorrect shape (broader base, altered stem), missing detailed engravings, and wrong color tone.
